senses.gloss: to have holes in one’s garments; to be clad in rags, be exposed. Part. פּוֹחֵחַ.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:6">Meg. IV, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Megillah 24a">24ᵃ</cite>); Tosef. ib. IV (III), 27 <he>פ׳ פורס וכ׳</he> one whose limbs are exposed may recite the Sh’mʿa (v. <cite ref="Q01908"><he>פָּרַס</he></cite>) &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 24b:2">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>קטן פ׳</he> a minor who is poorly dressed.
Treat. Sof’rim XIV, 15 פ׳ הנראים כרעיו וכ׳ a poḥeaḥ is he whose knees are exposed, whose garments are torn, or whose head is uncovered.
